::: {.about-section}

## About Me

Hi, this is Angel Yan!

Outside of class, you’ll probably find me playing tennis or badminton,
building LEGO Technic sets, taking photos, or planning my next trip.

I enjoy exploring different ways of telling stories through media,
photography, travel, and data visualization. I also like trying new things
and finding connections between my academic interests and the things I do
for fun.


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

library(ggplot2)

hobbies <- data.frame(
  hobby = c(
    "Travel",
    "Badminton",
    "Tennis",
    "LEGO",
    "Photography"
  ),
  percent = c(
    20,
    10,
    30,
    35,
    5
  )
)

ggplot(
  hobbies,
  aes(
    x = hobby,
    y = percent
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "white",
    fill = "#FFB6C0"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Where My Free Time Goes",
    subtitle = "An unofficial estimate",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent of free time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

:::
